pipeline_findings.finding: JHU BWA national rows 2009-02-05 (10 sCh) and 2009-02-24..03-02 (40 sCh/15 cCh/2 deaths) are cumulative-to-date totals, and JHU splits suspected (40) from confirmed (15) where the MoH total is 55 suspected incl. 15 confirmed. WHO annual 2008 (8/1) and 2009 (15/2) are cumulative snapshots of ONE outbreak (true total 55 suspected/15 confirmed/2 deaths, 19 Nov 2008-3 Mar 2009). The weekly builder therefore over-counts 2009 (~65.3 cases, ~4.04 deaths). JHU files are read-only, so the fix belongs in py/build_weekly_timeseries.py (or a JHU override list), not in this country run.
